title: Restore reserved inventory when an order is cancelled
intent: Add an order cancellation workflow that restores reserved inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelling an order restores the inventory quantity reserved for each of its line items
Cancelling an order that is not eligible for cancellation still raises a conflict error and does not touch inventory
Existing order creation and inventory reservation are unaffected
expected_risks: InventoryService.increase_stock already exists and is correct — this task wires OrderService.cancel_order to call it once per order item
Restoring inventory for an order that was already (incorrectly) cancellable twice would double-restore stock — must only run once per successful cancellation
expected_tests: cancelling a pending order restores the reserved inventory for each item
cancelling an ineligible order still fails and leaves inventory unchanged (regression)
expected_failure_modes: cancel_order updates status but never calls InventoryService to restore stock (current gap)
